script: Hello. I am an AI presenter, speaking on behalf of Capital Q. Capital Q is an AI-native investment intelligence operating system for private capital. It is not a marketplace, or a CRM. Its purpose is to help founders and investors make better investment decisions, by reducing the information gap between them. At its centre is Q, an investment intelligence analyst. Q learns an investor's thesis, and onboards businesses through a conversation. Evidence comes before opinion. What is verified is marked as verified, and what is unknown stays unknown. Investors set the criteria a business must meet before it can contact them, so founders present once, in a structure investors can compare like for like. Capital Q is built by FDN Capital Partners, in Lagos and Dubai. We are raising two million US dollars. The details are in our data room.
